description: Equal words and closes retain their different following original context (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text ($a:candidate Y $b:candidate Z) %conditions $a.without-elision.parse(rival), ¬$b.without-elision.parse(rival)

%rule candidate (X [+T])
%rule rival ($v:X [+T]) %conditions $v.following-tokens.parse(next …)

%rule next Y
